SELECT 
    di.makername,
    di.modnum,
    di.dpires AS dpi_resolution,
    ts.pollratehz AS polling_rate,
    ROUND(CAST((di.dpires::numeric / 1000.0) * (1.0 - di.mcresptime / 10.0) * 10.0 AS numeric), 2) AS sensor_quality_score,
    ROUND(CAST((m.ergorate::numeric / 10.0) * (1.0 + CASE WHEN m.wristflag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END / 5.0) * (1.0 - ABS(m.palmangle - 15)::numeric / 45.0) * 10.0 AS numeric), 2) AS comfort_index,
    CASE 
        WHEN (di.dpires::numeric / 1000.0) * (1.0 - di.mcresptime / 10.0) * 10.0 > 7.5
         AND di.dpires >= 16000
         AND ts.pollratehz >= 1000
         AND (m.ergorate::numeric / 10.0) * (1.0 + CASE WHEN m.wristflag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END / 5.0) * (1.0 - ABS(m.palmangle - 15)::numeric / 45.0) * 10.0 > 8.0
        THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS premium_device
FROM deviceidentity di
JOIN testsessions ts ON di.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
JOIN mechanical m ON di.devregistry = m.mechdevref
WHERE ts.devscope = 'Mouse'
ORDER BY sensor_quality_score DESC, comfort_index DESC
LIMIT 10
